findings.text: follow-on: this file is outside the node's fenced write paths yet its body-still-running case had to change from landed False to landed None; the edit is entailed by the new behaviour and keeps its coverage, but the scope deviation was not requested from the coordinator.

follow-on: the landed-None message and hint at reckon/_mcp_tools.py:195 and :212-215 assert "the write is still in flight", but landed None is also produced by the stat-timeout path at reckon/mcp_deadlines.py:251, where the abandoned body may already have finished; the message names one cause of two.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against base 3b5e72d0; 234584d5e changes the landing check and the None wording/hint (reckon/mcp_deadlines.py, reckon/_mcp_tools.py), and 41d19bbd9 adds the three-case test and re-specifies the body-still-running case in tests/test_mcp_reads_have_deadlines.py.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names tests/test_a_write_in_flight_is_not_reported_unlanded.py driving the write deadline with three bodies; gate-head2.log records "232 passed" (EXIT=0) at head 41d19bbd9 and gate-base2.log "229 passed" (EXIT=0) at base 3b5e72d0, a delta of exactly the three new cases with no failure at head absent at base.
item_verdicts.goal: the node goal is to report a timed-out write whose body is still running as landed unknown rather than false; reckon/mcp_deadlines.py:225 returns False only when the abandoned body's future is done and the file is unchanged, and :228 returns None when the body is still running at the grace end, which is the goal.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records the gate command and result, base/head arms with their logs, a declared negative control with its log, and names files that exist on disk.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the dispatch fence named reckon/mcp_deadlines.py, reckon/_mcp_tools.py, tests/test_a_write_in_flight_is_not_reported_unlanded.py, the evidence fragment and a figures directory; git diff 3b5e72d0..41d19bbd9 changes the first three plus tests/test_mcp_reads_have_deadlines.py, which is outside the fence.

justifications.durability: reinstating the old behaviour (answer False whenever the grace ends with the file unchanged) in a scratch tree reddens tests/test_a_write_in_flight_is_not_reported_unlanded.py:85 with "assert False is None", and the shipped negative-control.log records the same failure at EXIT=1.
justifications.evidence: gate-head2.log records "232 passed" (EXIT=0) and gate-base2.log "229 passed" (EXIT=0), with no failure at head absent at base, and the manifest's baseline_suite/after_suite carry revision, command, completed=true and empty failure_ids.
justifications.fit: reckon/mcp_deadlines.py:225 and reckon/_mcp_tools.py:212 follow the surrounding style of the landing check and for_call, and introduce no forbidden name, though the landed-None message at reckon/_mcp_tools.py:195 names one cause of two.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/mcp_deadlines.py:225 returns False only when the abandoned body's future is done with the file unchanged, and :228 returns None when it is still running at the grace end, so a still-in-flight write is no longer reported not-landed.
justifications.reuse: the change reads the future _InflightBody already holds (reckon/mcp_deadlines.py:394) rather than keeping a second completion record; a search of reckon/ for a body-completion mechanism finds only the read-side add_done_callback at reckon/mcp_deadlines.py:436, so no existing owner is forked.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --stat 3b5e72d0..41d19bbd9 changes tests/test_mcp_reads_have_deadlines.py, which the dispatch fence did not list among the node's write paths.
